images.label: Figure 1
images.caption: Figure 1. Outline of the Early Steps of Taxol Biosynthesis. GGPP cyclization to taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene followed by P450-mediated formation of taxa-4(20),11(12)-dien-5α-ol.

images.label: Figure 2
images.caption: Figure 2. Deduced Amino Acid Sequence Alignment of Taxoid Hydroxylases. T10H, T13H and S1/T5H; black boxes identical in all three sequences, gray in two.

images.label: Figure 3
images.caption: Figure 3. Substrate Binding of Taxadiene Isomers. A: 4(20) isomer Ks 4±1 μM; B: 4(5) isomer Ks 6.5±1.5 μM. Recombinant S1-enriched microsomes, 200 pmol P450. Complete original two plots and caption.

images.label: Figure 4
images.caption: Figure 4. Kinetic Evaluation of Taxadiene Isomers. Filled circles 4(20), open circles 4(5). A recombinant S1 50 pmol; B total native P450 about 50 pmol. Original caption averages 21.5 μM/135 and 36 μM/100 differ from body system-specific parameters; preserved and explicitly distinguished.

images.label: Figure 5
images.caption: Figure 5. Proposed Mechanism for Cytochrome P450 Taxadiene 5α-Hydroxylase. Proposed C20 or C5 hydrogen abstraction converges on allylic radical 8 and 5α oxygenation. No direct intermediate detection; original complete structures and caption.
